## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes (unit / integration / contract / e2e as appropriate)
- [ ] Event contracts: changes are additive, or a new version (`.v2`) is introduced alongside v1
- [ ] Migrations are new files (existing migrations are never edited)
- [ ] Documentation, ADRs and diagrams updated where behaviour changed (`npm run docs:validate`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files or personal data committed
